items.title: Sheryl Bailey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 24, 2023
items.q: on a different art form, stand-up comedy is Joan Rivers. I recommend this movie, “Joan Rivers: A Piece of Work.”

ctx.x: You know I felt so naive for a long time thinking about how jazz musicians live and make a living. And I recall — he must have just said it in passing after our interview — about you know, “Yeah well like tomorrow I’m playing a wedding.” And I’m thinking Gene Bertoncini plays weddings. And after hearing that from a lot of musicians, well of course I do that, would you rather I wait tables or something? And it was very informative to realize that.

Um hum. Yeah well you know what’s a great — on a different art form, stand-up comedy is Joan Rivers. I recommend this movie, “Joan Rivers: A Piece of Work.” That first twenty minutes of that movie really shows a working freelance artist. That woman hustled gigs to the day she died. And you know she was like sometimes you’re playing at the biggest hall in Vegas or whatever and you’ve got a long one, sometimes you’re doing a bar mitzvah. You do everything with the same integrity. They’re not different — and I know…
Um hum. He had a degree in architecture.
